Council Meetings

Meetings of Coonamble Shire Council are open to the public. Council meets on the second Wednesday of each month (except January) from 9am. Council meetings are held at the Coonamble Shire Council chambers, with the exception of meetings held annually at Gulargambone (March) and Quambone (August). 

Council conducts its meeting in accordance with its Code of Meeting Practice:

Code of Meeting Practice - adopted November 2025

Copies of the business paper for each meeting are available to the public on Council's website and at the Council Administration Centre, 80 Castlereagh Street, Coonamble about one week before the scheduled meeting.

Attendance of members of the public at Council meetings

Members of the public are welcome to attend those sections of Council meetings not deemed confidential. They do so as observers and do not speak to the meeting or enter into debate.

Community Consultation Sessions 

Members of the public may formally address an item on the agenda of a meeting by submitting a request at least a day before the meeting. Please complete the 'Application to Speak' Form, and submit it by noon on the day before the meeting and in accordance with Council’s Code of Meeting Practice and Community Consultation Session Policy. If approved, the individual may speak for five minutes (maximum). 

Individuals wishing to address Council should familiarise themselves with both the Community Consultation Session Policy and the Code of Meeting Practice, both available for download from the links in the above paragraph.

Informal chats with Councillors

Some Councillors make themselves available 30 minutes before the Council meeting begins. Members of the public are welcome to join these Councillors for informal chats. You can also reach out to Councillors by email or mobile phone at the contact points listed here.
